description: The demo sound.dll (link time 0x3b982899, debug) is an earlier build than retail. Each of the 72 field proposals rests on a retail instruction that touches [this + offset] in a slot body whose fields and imports equal the demo body's. The member name and type come from the demo record. Retail class sizes are confirmed for only five classes: their set_total_class_size constants (0x10005d40, 0x1001c510, 0x1001c6c0, 0x1001c930, 0x1001cb80) equal the demo sizes. For the other classes, a member the retail build added, removed or moved would show up only as an offset that no retail access confirms.
path to resolution: Compare each class's retail allocation size (operator new argument before its ctor) with the demo size; extend fieldprop.py to non-virtual functions once they are mapped.

description: The demo's mmx_filter_table (24 slots at demo 0x10065990) and the retail table at 0x1005b830 (25 slots) stay unpaired: the slot counts differ. Both sit right after the CMidiMgr vtable, but which retail slot is the extra one was not measured.
path to resolution: Compare the 25 retail bodies with the demo's 24 by fields (slotfeat.py on a manual pairing).

description: The demo holds two one-slot tables between CMidiMgr and Sound_Device: CMMError and CSndWin. Retail holds one, at 0x1005b8ac. The LCS paired it with CSndWin. Whether retail dropped CMMError's vtable or merged the two tables was not determined.
path to resolution: Find the retail installers of 0x1005b8ac and compare them with the demo installers of both tables.

description: 118 retail slot bodies are constant or empty stubs that the demo names: get_listener_xpos, set_attrib and others. S10.9's rule rejects a name when no instruction supports its verb, so they stay unnamed even though the slot itself is identified.
path to resolution: Lead decision: keep the stub rule, or accept slot names for stubs with a marker such as a `_stub` suffix.

description: MidiCtrlTarget::start_control and CMidiTrack::start_control call slot +0x10 (do_control in the demo record) of every control in the list at this+0xc whose m_type (+0x1c) is 3, 4 or 5 (0x1001bd0d, 0x1001e87c). What types 3..5 are (enum MIDI_CONTROL) was not read from the demo's LF_ENUM records, so the verb start is not tied.
path to resolution: Read the MIDI_CONTROL enumerators with cv_debug.py (LF_ENUMERATE in the field list) and check them against the retail body.
